title: डलरको मुठो देखाएर नेपाली पैसा लुट्ने सुजन- गेस्टहाउसका बोर्डबाट नम्बर टिप्थे, ठगेपछि सीम फ्याँक्थे
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । विदेशी मुद्रा (अमेरिकी डलर) को मुठो देखाएर लाखौँ नेपाली रुपैयाँ ठगी तथा लुटपाट गर्दै आएका एक व्यक्तिलाई प्रहरीले गोली प्रहार गरी पक्राउ गरेको छ। पक्राउ पर्नेमा सिन्धुपाल्चोकको बाह्रबिसे स्थायी ठेगाना भई हाल काठमाडौँको बौद्ध बस्दै आएका २८ वर्षीय सुजन तामाङ छन् । उनलाई बिहीबार काठमाडौँको गोकर्णेश्वर नगरपालिका–३, गाम्चाबाट नियन्त्रणमा लिइएको जिल्ला प्रहरी परिसर काठमाडौँले पत्रकार सम्मेलन गरी जानकारी दिएको हो। कपनको खोर्सानीटार र बूढानीलकण्ठ क्षेत्रमा डलर ठगी भएको उजुरीका आधारमा खोजीमा खटिएको प्रहरी टोलीलाई देखेपछि तामाङले आक्रमणको प्रयास गरेका थिए। नियन्त्रणमा लिने क्रममा उनले प्रहरी जवानमाथि गोली प्रहार गरेपछि स्थिति नियन्त्रणमा लिन प्रहरीले एक राउन्ड हवाई र उनको घुँडामुनि एक राउन्ड जवाफी फायर गरेको थियो। घाइते तामाङलाई उपचारका लागि अस्पताल भर्ना गरिएको छ। काठमाडौं प्रहरी प्रमुख एसएसपी दिलिप घिमिरेका अनुसार तामाङ शृङ्खलाबद्ध अपराधमा संलग्न व्यक्ति हुन्। उनका विरुद्ध यसअघि नै काठमाडौं र ललितपुरको सातदोबाटोमा गरी आठ वटा ठगी तथा लुटपाटका मुद्दा दर्ता छन्। पछिल्लो समय उनी बूढानीलकण्ठ, साँखु, स्वयम्भू हुँदै काभ्रेपलाञ्चोकसम्म ठगी सञ्जाल विस्तार गर्न सक्रिय थिए। यस्तो थियो ठगीको काइदा प्रहरीको प्रारम्भिक अनुसन्धान अनुसार तामाङले ठगीका लागि निकै चतुर योजना बनाउने गर्थे। उनी विभिन्न गेस्टहाउसका फोटो खिचेर मोबाइलमा राख्थे र त्यहाँको साइनबोर्डमा रहेको नम्बरमा फोन गर्थे। फोनमा ‘तपाईंको होटलमा बसेको थिएँ, खाएको थिएँ’ भन्दै चिनजानको बहाना बनाउँथे। त्यसपछि ‘मसँग धेरै डलर छ, सस्तो मूल्यमा साट्यो भने निकै फाइदा हुन्छ’ भन्दै प्रलोभनमा पार्थे। १५–२० डलरका केही नोटलाई बाहिर राखेर कागजको मुठो बनाउँथे र पाँचदेखि १० लाख रुपैयाँमा बिक्री गर्न खोज्थे। कारोबारका लागि उनले प्रहरी र सीसीटीभीको पहुँच नभएका नाङ्गलेभारे, लप्सीफेदी, सुन्दरीजलजस्ता एकान्त र विकट स्थान रोज्ने गर्थे। ग्राहकले नेपाली रकम हातमा दिनासाथ डलरको मुठो खोलेझैँ नाटक गरी रकम र डलर दुवै लिएर उनी फरार हुन्थे। घटनापछि भाग्न उनले तत्कालै मोटरसाइकलको नम्बर प्लेट र लगाएको लुगा फेर्ने गर्थे। विशेष कुरा, उनले एउटा ठगीमा प्रयोग गरेको मोबाइलको सीमकार्ड तत्कालै नष्ट गर्ने र नयाँ ठगीका लागि नयाँ सीमकार्ड प्रयोग गर्ने गरेको खुलेको छ। तामाङको यस गिरोहमा अन्य व्यक्तिहरू पनि संलग्न रहेको र उनीहरूको खोजी भइरहेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ। उनीविरुद्ध काभ्रेमा भएका ठगीका घटनाबारे जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय काभ्रेले समेत थप अनुसन्धान अघि बढाएको छ। Kathmandu: Police have arrested a man who was involved in fraud and robbery worth millions of Nepali rupees by showing bundles of foreign currency (US dollars). The arrested person is 28-year-old Sujan Tamang, who has a permanent address in Barhabise, Sindhupalchowk and currently lives in Bouddha, Kathmandu. He was taken into custody from Gamcha, Gokarneshwor Municipality-3, Kathmandu on Thursday, informed the District Police Range, Kathmandu, at a press conference. Tamang attempted to attack after seeing a police team deployed in the Khorsanitar and Budhanilkantha areas of Kapan based on a complaint of dollar fraud. He opened fire on a policeman while being taken into custody, after which the police fired one round in the air and one round under his knee to bring the situation under control. The injured Tamang has been admitted to the hospital for treatment. According to Kathmandu Police Chief SSP Dilip Ghimire, Tamang is involved in a series of crimes. He already has eight cases of fraud and robbery registered against him in Kathmandu and Lalitpur, including in Satdobato. Recently, he was active in expanding his fraud network to Kavrepalanchok via Budhanilkantha, Sankhu, and Swayambhu. This was the trick of cheating. According to the initial police investigation, Tamang used to devise a very clever plan for fraud. He would take photos of various guesthouses, save them on his mobile phone, and call the number on the signboard there. He would pretend to know them by saying, 'I had stayed at your hotel, I had eaten at your hotel.' Then he would tempt them by saying, 'I have a lot of dollars, if you exchange them at a cheap rate, you will make a lot of profit.' He would put some 15-20 dollar notes outside, make a bundle of paper and try to sell them for 5 to 1 million rupees. For his business, he would choose secluded and remote places like Nanglebhare, Lapsiphedi, and Sundarijal, which were inaccessible to the police and CCTV, and as soon as the customer handed over the Nepali currency, he would pretend to open a bundle of dollars and escape with both the currency and the dollars. After the incident, he would immediately change the motorcycle's number plate and the clothes he was wearing to escape. Notably, it has been revealed that he would immediately destroy the SIM card of the mobile phone used in one fraud and use a new SIM card for a new fraud. Police have stated that other people are also involved in Tamang's gang and they are being searched for. The District Police Office, Kavre has also initiated further investigation into the fraud cases against him in Kavre.

रकम र डलर दुवै लिएर उनी फरार हुन्थे। घटनापछि भाग्न उनले तत्कालै मोटरसाइकलको नम्बर प्लेट र लगाएको लुगा फेर्ने गर्थे। विशेष कुरा, उनले एउटा ठगीमा प्रयोग गरेको मोबाइलको सीमकार्ड तत्कालै नष्ट गर्ने र नयाँ ठगीका लागि नयाँ सीमकार्ड प्रयोग गर्ने गरेको खुलेको छ। तामाङको यस गिरोहमा अन्य व्यक्तिहरू पनि संलग्न रहेको र उनीहरूको खोजी भइरहेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ। उनीविरुद्ध काभ्रेमा भएका ठगीका घटनाबारे जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय काभ्रेले समेत थप अनुसन्धान अघि बढाएको छ। Kathmandu: Police have arrested a man who was involved in fraud and robbery worth millions of Nepali rupees by showing bundles of foreign currency (US dollars). The arrested person is 28-year-old Sujan Tamang, who has a permanent address in Barhabise, Sindhupalchowk and currently lives in Bouddha, Kathmandu. He was taken into custody from Gamcha, Gokarneshwor Municipality-3, Kathmandu on Thursday, informed the District Police Range, Kathmandu, at a press conference. Tamang attempted to attack after seeing a police team deployed in the Khorsanitar and Budhanilkantha areas of Kapan based on a complaint of dollar fraud. He opened fire on a policeman while being taken into custody, after which the police fired one round in the air and one round under his knee to bring the situation under control. The injured Tamang has been admitted to the hospital for treatment. According to Kathmandu Police Chief SSP Dilip Ghimire, Tamang is involved in a series of crimes. He already has eight cases of fraud and robbery registered against him in Kathmandu and Lalitpur, including in Satdobato. Recently, he was active in expanding his fraud network to Kavrepalanchok via Budhanilkantha, Sankhu, and Swayambhu. This was the trick of cheating. According to the initial police investigation, Tamang used to devise a very clever plan for fraud. He would take photos of various guesthouses, save them on his mobile phone, and call the number on the signboard there. He would pretend to know them by saying, 'I had stayed at your hotel, I had eaten at your hotel.' Then he would tempt them by saying, 'I have a lot of dollars, if you exchange them at a cheap rate, you will make a lot of profit.' He would put some 15-20 dollar notes outside, make a bundle of paper and try to sell them for 5 to 1 million rupees. For his business, he would choose secluded and remote places like Nanglebhare, Lapsiphedi, and Sundarijal, which were inaccessible to the police and CCTV, and as soon as the customer handed over the Nepali currency, he would pretend to open a bundle of dollars and escape with both the currency and the dollars. After the incident, he would immediately change the motorcycle's number plate and the clothes he was wearing to escape. Notably, it has been revealed that he would immediately destroy the SIM card of the mobile phone used in one fraud and use a new SIM card for a new fraud. Police have stated that other people are also involved in Tamang's gang and they are being searched for. The District Police Office, Kavre has also initiated further investigation into the fraud cases against him in Kavre.

पर्नेमा सिन्धुपाल्चोकको बाह्रबिसे स्थायी ठेगाना भई हाल काठमाडौँको बौद्ध बस्दै आएका २८ वर्षीय सुजन तामाङ छन् । उनलाई बिहीबार काठमाडौँको गोकर्णेश्वर नगरपालिका–३, गाम्चाबाट नियन्त्रणमा लिइएको जिल्ला प्रहरी परिसर काठमाडौँले पत्रकार सम्मेलन गरी जानकारी दिएको हो। कपनको खोर्सानीटार र बूढानीलकण्ठ क्षेत्रमा डलर ठगी भएको उजुरीका आधारमा खोजीमा खटिएको प्रहरी टोलीलाई देखेपछि तामाङले आक्रमणको प्रयास गरेका थिए। नियन्त्रणमा लिने क्रममा उनले प्रहरी जवानमाथि गोली प्रहार गरेपछि स्थिति नियन्त्रणमा लिन प्रहरीले एक राउन्ड हवाई र उनको घुँडामुनि एक राउन्ड जवाफी फायर गरेको थियो। घाइते तामाङलाई उपचारका लागि अस्पताल भर्ना गरिएको छ। काठमाडौं प्रहरी प्रमुख एसएसपी दिलिप घिमिरेका अनुसार तामाङ शृङ्खलाबद्ध अपराधमा संलग्न व्यक्ति हुन्। उनका विरुद्ध यसअघि नै काठमाडौं र ललितपुरको सातदोबाटोमा गरी आठ वटा ठगी तथा लुटपाटका मुद्दा दर्ता छन्। पछिल्लो समय उनी बूढानीलकण्ठ, साँखु, स्वयम्भू हुँदै काभ्रेपलाञ्चोकसम्म ठगी सञ्जाल विस्तार गर्न सक्रिय थिए। यस्तो थियो ठगीको काइदा प्रहरीको प्रारम्भिक अनुसन्धान अनुसार तामाङले सम्मेलन गरी जानकारी दिएको हो। कपनको खोर्सानीटार र बूढानीलकण्ठ क्षेत्रमा डलर ठगी भएको उजुरीका आधारमा खोजीमा खटिएको प्रहरी टोलीलाई देखेपछि तामाङले आक्रमणको प्रयास गरेका थिए। नियन्त्रणमा लिने क्रममा उनले प्रहरी जवानमाथि गोली प्रहार गरेपछि स्थिति नियन्त्रणमा लिन प्रहरीले एक राउन्ड हवाई र उनको घुँडामुनि एक राउन्ड जवाफी फायर गरेको थियो। घाइते तामाङलाई उपचारका लागि अस्पताल भर्ना गरिएको छ। काठमाडौं प्रहरी प्रमुख एसएसपी दिलिप घिमिरेका अनुसार तामाङ शृङ्खलाबद्ध अपराधमा संलग्न व्यक्ति हुन्। उनका विरुद्ध यसअघि नै काठमाडौं र ललितपुरको सातदोबाटोमा गरी आठ वटा ठगी तथा लुटपाटका मुद्दा दर्ता छन्। पछिल्लो समय उनी बूढानीलकण्ठ, साँखु, स्वयम्भू हुँदै काभ्रेपलाञ्चोकसम्म ठगी सञ्जाल विस्तार गर्न सक्रिय थिए। यस्तो थियो ठगीको काइदा प्रहरीको प्रारम्भिक अनुसन्धान अनुसार तामाङले ठगीका लागि निकै चतुर योजना बनाउने गर्थे। उनी विभिन्न गेस्टहाउसका फोटो खिचेर मोबाइलमा राख्थे र त्यहाँको साइनबोर्डमा रहेको नम्बरमा फोन गर्थे। फोनमा ‘तपाईंको होटलमा बसेको थिएँ, खाएको थिएँ’ भन्दै चिनजानको बहाना बनाउँथे। त्यसपछि ‘मसँग धेरै डलर छ, सस्तो मूल्यमा साट्यो भने निकै फाइदा हुन्छ’ भन्दै प्रलोभनमा पार्थे। १५–२० डलरका केही नोटलाई बाहिर राखेर कागजको मुठो बनाउँथे र पाँचदेखि १० लाख रुपैयाँमा बिक्री गर्न खोज्थे। कारोबारका लागि उनले प्रहरी र सीसीटीभीको पहुँच नभएका नाङ्गलेभारे, लप्सीफेदी, सुन्दरीजलजस्ता एकान्त र विकट स्थान रोज्ने गर्थे। ग्राहकले नेपाली रकम हातमा दिनासाथ डलरको मुठो खोलेझैँ नाटक गरी रकम र डलर दुवै लिएर उनी फरार हुन्थे। घटनापछि भाग्न उनले तत्कालै मोटरसाइकलको नम्बर प्लेट र लगाएको लुगा फेर्ने गर्थे। विशेष कुरा, उनले एउटा ठगीमा प्रयोग गरेको मोबाइलको सीमकार्ड तत्कालै नष्ट गर्ने र नयाँ ठगीका लागि नयाँ सीमकार्ड प्रयोग गर्ने गरेको खुलेको छ। तामाङको यस गिरोहमा अन्य व्यक्तिहरू पनि संलग्न रहेको र उनीहरूको खोजी भइरहेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ। उनीविरुद्ध काभ्रेमा भएका ठगीका घटनाबारे जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय काभ्रेले समेत थप अनुसन्धान अघि बढाएको छ।

Kathmandu: Police have arrested a man who was involved in fraud and robbery worth millions of Nepali rupees by showing bundles of foreign currency (US dollars). The arrested person is 28-year-old Sujan Tamang, who has a permanent address in Barhabise, Sindhupalchowk and currently lives in Bouddha, Kathmandu. He was taken into custody from Gamcha, Gokarneshwor Municipality-3, Kathmandu on Thursday, informed the District Police Range, Kathmandu, at a press conference. Tamang attempted to attack after seeing a police team deployed in the Khorsanitar and Budhanilkantha areas of Kapan based on a complaint of dollar fraud. He opened fire on a policeman while being taken into custody, after which the police fired one round in the air and one round under his knee to bring the situation under control. The injured Tamang has been admitted to the hospital for treatment. According to Kathmandu Police Chief SSP Dilip Ghimire, Tamang is involved in a series of crimes. He already has eight cases of fraud and robbery registered against him in Kathmandu and Lalitpur, including in Satdobato. Recently, he was active in expanding his fraud network to Kavrepalanchok via Budhanilkantha, Sankhu, and Swayambhu. This was the trick of cheating. According to the initial police investigation, Tamang used to devise a very clever plan for fraud. He would take photos of various guesthouses, save them on his mobile phone, and call the number on the signboard there. He would pretend to know them by saying, 'I had stayed at your hotel, I had eaten at your hotel.' Then he would tempt them by saying, 'I have a lot of dollars, if you exchange them at a cheap rate, you will make a lot of profit.' He would put some 15-20 dollar notes outside, make a bundle of paper and try to sell them for 5 to 1 million rupees. For his business, he would choose secluded and remote places like Nanglebhare, Lapsiphedi, and Sundarijal, which were inaccessible to the police and CCTV, and as soon as the customer handed over the Nepali currency, he would pretend to open a bundle of dollars and escape with both the currency and the dollars. After the incident, he would immediately change the motorcycle's number plate and the clothes he was wearing to escape. Notably, it has been revealed that he would immediately destroy the SIM card of the mobile phone used in one fraud and use a new SIM card for a new fraud. Police have stated that other people are also involved in Tamang's gang and they are being searched for. The District Police Office, Kavre has also initiated further investigation into the fraud cases against him in Kavre.
